big_picture.summary_en: US 30-year Treasury yields reached levels last seen in 2002 as the selloff deepened, pushing borrowing costs higher and pressuring equities. Reports indicate bipartisan efforts to restrict AI chip exports to China are advancing, creating direct policy risk for NVDA AMD TSM MU.
